profile.headline: C/C++/Embedded/Python Software Developer with 20 years of experience in the aerospace and communications industries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed C/C++ embedded software for the Electronic Fuel Hydraulic Display (EFHD) for
military aircraft. The EFHD retrieves data such as fuel weight, fuel tank probe status, 
hydraulic oil pressure, etc. from communication ports such as synchros, discrete, RS422
serial ports for displaying in graphical format.
● Developed a test tool in Python to support the qualification test of the EFHD. This Graphical
User Interface (GUI) application allows the user to enter input data via Input Entries,
Checkboxes and sends the input data to the EFHD via RS442 Serial port. The second thread
of this multi-threaded application receives output data from the EFHD for displaying via
Output Entries and Checkboxes.
● Designed and implemented the ARINC 717 Application in C/C++ to record Digital Flight
Data in the NEXIS™ Electronic Flight Bag (EFB).
● Implemented software update in C++ for the Terminal Chart and Moving Maps, a software
part of the EFB. This software reads Jeppesen Charts Database to display Terminal Chart and
Maps superimposed with aircraft position.
● Designed and implemented the Software Pin Programming (SPP) in C/C++. This Integrity
RTOS software reads configuration data installed on the Network Server System (NSS) and
broadcast the data on the AFDX and ARIN 429 networks of the aircraft.
● Developed Unit Level Test for the Digital Signal Processor Library (DO-178B Level A), part
of Electronic Instrument Display. Ran Code Coverage using CodeTest tool and produced
Coverage Analysis.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented CPU binding function for Call Processing Threads.
● Designed and implemented a performance benchmark for Linux kernel version 2.6.
● Developed the Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) using Perl.
● Validated Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP)/IP (RFC 2960) protocol
conformance. Analyzed and troubleshot SCTP issues. Developed and maintained an
application programming interface (API) to SCTP.
● Primary Author of a System Audit Utility using Korn shell. The utility is menu-driven to
analyze system performance, collect logs, and collect system statistics.
● Investigated and resolved issues in real-time on deployed sites, in system test labs, and
fielded sites.
● Responsible for root cause analysis and performing product improvements to address
software defects for several major subsystems on Motorola’s CDMA Base Station Controller
(BSC) product.
● Functional Area Coordinator for a team of eight to ten software engineers. Responsible for
managing developer productivity on maintenance improvements.
